setup_training: setup training with accelerator, dataloaders, optimizer, ema model, and lr scheduler for diffusion model fine-tuning
setup_model_and_optimizer: setup model and optimizer with EMA, xformers, gradient checkpointing, and per-group learning rates for UNet fine-tuning
setup_train_val_dataloaders: setup train and validation data loaders from CO3D configs with optional dreambooth prior preservation dataset
save_checkpoint: save accelerator training state to a checkpoint directory with automatic old checkpoint cleanup
load_checkpoint: load the most recent or specified checkpoint and return global step, first epoch, and resume step for training resumption
